text:
katie-cs: @maria-support KestrelBay reporting sudden p95/p99 regressions since ~09:10 UTC, chatty on embeds. Customer says median ok but p99 up to 7.8s and some 504s. Can we triage?

maria-support: thanks — checking logs now, can you DM tenant_id? I'll pull traces.

katie-cs: tenant_id KEST-77, example request_id `req_0x9a3b` — they sent a 1000-item embed batch around 09:09. Customer on hosted plan.

maria-support: I see repeated `queue_time` spikes and `backend_timeout` logs on router-11. Also a lot of concurrent long-running sessions from same tenant IP :thinking_face:

aj-runtime: pinging infra — @sam-oncall did we deploy the new batching heuristics last night to the cluster that serves KestrelBay?

sam-oncall: we rolled a small kernel tweak at 02:00 UTC to improve cache pinning; didn't expect regressions. Looking at metrics: kube pod restarts on shard-7 around 09:05, OOM kills correlated with a noisy tenant ramp.

leo-sre: adding data — `top` snapshot from node shows one go process at 96% GPU memory usage, many small sessions. Likely KV-cache pressure + prefill per-request causing eviction delays.

maria-support: customer confirmed they ramped up a new campaign at 09:00 with large multi-embed requests. Could be noisy neighbor.

aj-runtime: mitigation options: 1) add tenant to short allowlist to route to dedicated reservation, 2) apply per-tenant throttling (rate-limit concurrent requests), 3) temporary model variant with smaller context. Immediate fastest is per-tenant throttle or reservation allowlist.

sam-oncall: I can add a temporary throttle: limit concurrent requests from KEST-77 to 8 and cap batch size to 16. Applying now — will post results.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `throttle-config v2026-03-18.1` targeting tenant:KEST-77 — started.

sam-oncall: throttle applied — preliminary: p99 dropped from ~7.8s -> ~2.1s over 3m, 504s stopped. Customer reports better UX. :thumbsup:

katie-cs: wow nice, customer says errors cleared. Please keep monitoring and propose follow-up.

aj-runtime: next steps: (a) schedule reserved reservation for KEST-77 if sustained, (b) add a long-term per-tenant qps safeguard in router to avoid single-tenant eviction storms, (c) update ops runbook with repro: large batch embed + context pin causing KV thrash.

maria-support: I've flagged account and recommended reduced burst for the customer; scheduled a sync with their infra team at 14:00 UTC to review burst plan.

leo-sre: saving logs and traces: `logs/kestrel/2498765432/` pulled and attached to ticket #INC-4572.

sam-oncall: leaving throttle for 2 hours, will rollback if stable. :hourglass: 

katie-cs: thanks team. Can someone add a short note to postmortem template: "noisy tenant multi-embed bursts cause KV cache thrash -> per-tenant soft throttle effective" ?

aj-runtime: will do. Also adding metric dashboard alert: tenant_concurrent_sessions > 50 triggers auto-soft-throttle.

maria-support: customer happy for now, they'll confirm after their next campaign run. Closing loop in 4 hours unless regression.

katie-cs: awesome. :rocket:
